description: Angular Standalone Signals + OnPush + Strictly Typed Reactive Forms & Vitest/Playwright Frontend Architecture

recommended_surface_bindings.description: Standalone components, Signals-first reactivity, OnPush change detection, strict TypeScript, and 100% isolated component unit tests
invariants: Every Angular component is standalone: true with ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush and Signals-first state (signal, computed, input, output)
Feature domain facades and HTTP adapters are injected via inject() using abstract InjectionToken or interface contracts; components never call HttpClient directly
Strict TypeScript (strict: true, strictTemplates: true, noImplicitOverride: true) with zero any types and 100% isolated unit branch coverage
